title: Test without an open port
summary: Fastify: Test without an open port. Change the route score and check the test output.
introduction: inject runs a request inside Fastify. This example prints the response body and closes the app without listening.
learningObjectives: Test without an open port with Fastify

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Test without an open port

blocks.text: inject executes GET /score in memory. response.body is the JSON string from that route.
Change the route score and check the test output.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Close the app after tests so resources are released.
